rules.notes: Does nothing to any item the player has locked in-game (ESO item lock), across all categories. Locked is an explicit user signal to protect an item from sell / deconstruct / move; this rule honors it by claiming locked items first so no lower-priority rule can act on them. Positioned at the top of the user rules. NOTE: the 7 automation-controlled stock rules (food, drink, potions, soul-gems, repair-kits, lockpicks, scrolls) are prepended ABOVE all user rules at export, so a locked item in one of those categories can still be stocked/moved by a controlled rule before reaching this guard — protecting those would require a controlled-rule change.
rules.title: Protect locked items

rules.notes: Keeps up to 1,000,000 gold on each character. Excess is deposited into the bank when visiting.
rules.title: Stock gold

rules.notes: Deposits alliance points, tel var stones, and writ vouchers into the bank when visiting.
rules.title: Bank other currencies

rules.notes: Full 200-stacks route to the Walton Mountain guild bank; the lower-priority Erin rule keeps the partial remainder (first-match-wins).
rules.title: Full container stacks → Walton Mountain

rules.notes: Deposits stackable containers (reward coffers, event boxes, etc.) in the bank. Open them later in bulk or save for events.
rules.title: Bank stackable containers

rules.notes: Destroys known containers (reward already owned) with guild-store value < 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g line.

Opens containers automatically. The Can Open filter skips containers on game cooldown or when transmute crystal storage is full. The Can Give Max Rewards filter skips containers during the 20-hour reward cooldown.
rules.title: Open containers

rules.notes: Prevents epic (purple) quality or higher companion equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Place above sell and deconstruct rules to safeguard your best companion gear.
rules.title: Protect epic+ companion gear

rules.notes: Prevents legendary (gold) quality equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Place above sell and deconstruct rules to safeguard your best gear.
rules.title: Protect legendary gear

rules.notes: Prevents crafted equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Useful for keeping gear you've invested materials into.
rules.title: Protect crafted gear

rules.notes: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen food to the Food and Drink housing storage container, keeping bulky quality food out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality food is relocated rather than left loose.
rules.title: Store quality food

rules.notes: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen drink to the Food and Drink housing storage container, keeping bulky quality drink out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality drink is relocated rather than left loose.
rules.title: Store quality drink

rules.notes: Gap B1: bank is the deliberate stock home (2-3 chars at a time, manual pulls). Replaces the lock. Must run before f0ce7528.
rules.title: Crown tri-pots stay banked

rules.notes: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen potions to the Potions and Poisons housing storage container, keeping bulky quality potions out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality potions are relocated rather than left loose.
rules.title: Store quality potions

rules.notes: Moves blue (Superior) and higher non-stolen poisons to the Potions and Poisons housing storage container, keeping bulky quality poisons out of the backpack. Sits above the crafted-consumables protection so crafted quality poisons are relocated rather than left loose.
rules.title: Store quality poisons

rules.notes: Prevents crafted food, drink, potions, poisons, and glyphs from being affected by lower-priority rules. Crafted consumables take ingredients and time to make — this keeps them safe from accidental sell or destroy rules.
rules.title: Protect crafted consumables

rules.notes: Prevents reconstructed equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Reconstructed gear costs transmute crystals and set collection knowledge.
rules.title: Protect reconstructed gear

rules.notes: Prevents transmuted equipment from being affected by lower-priority rules. Transmuted gear represents a transmute crystal investment.
rules.title: Protect transmuted gear

rules.notes: Launders stolen items that can teach something (motifs, recipes, etc.) so they can be used. Place before other unlock rules.
rules.title: Launder stolen unlockables

rules.notes: Sells Psijic Ambrosia recipe fragments (Fragment I–IV) regardless of quality. Item: 64702–64705.
rules.title: Sell Psijic Ambrosia recipe fragments

rules.notes: Destroys style pages already learned (canUnlock=cannot-unlock) with guild-store value < 5000g and no merchant sell value (merchantValue 0). Pairs with the >=5000g list rule to close the 1000-5000g gap: learned + below-list-threshold + unsellable -> destroy. Destroy is default-confirmed via the safety dialog.
rules.title: Destroy learned style pages below the 5000g list line

rules.notes: Lists style pages you cannot unlock (already known / wrong class) with guild-store value >= 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g list line.
rules.title: List learned valuable style pages on guild store

rules.notes: Uses items that teach something new — motifs, recipes, style pages, furnishing plans, etc. If the current character can learn the item, it's used immediately. For recipes (character-specific knowledge), the addon checks the current character only (ESO API limitation).
rules.title: Use unlockables

rules.notes: Launders stolen lockpicks so they can be banked or used instead of fence-sold.
rules.title: Launder stolen lockpicks

rules.notes: Vendor-sells furnishings with guild-store value < 5000g (excluding legendary). Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g line; furnishings >= 5000g still route to furniture-vault via furnishings-house-storage.
rules.title: Sell low-value furnishings

rules.notes: Moves furnishings to the furniture vault (house storage) when visiting the bank. Keeps your backpack clear of bulky furniture items.
rules.title: Store furniture in housing

rules.notes: Gap A2: fuzzy reserve parked with the other trophies (Alan 2026-07-03). First-class category since #14629.
rules.title: Skill scrolls to Trophies

rules.notes: Lists any item with guild-store value (marketValue) >= 5000g that can be listed at a guild trader. Single guild-value gate (no vendor-value constraint). Pairs with low-quality-sell: >=5000 list, <5000 vendor-sell.
rules.title: List items worth >=5000g at guild store

rules.notes: Launders stolen equipment with a researchable trait so it can be submitted at a crafting station. Place before other research rules.
rules.title: Launder stolen researchables

rules.notes: Routes equipment with researchable traits to the character that needs them most. Characters are checked in priority order using TemperCharacters saved variable data for cross-character trait knowledge. The current character is checked first via the ESO API; others are checked via saved data.
rules.title: Research traits

rules.notes: Sells equipment with the Ornate trait. Ornate items sell for more gold at merchants and have no crafting use.
rules.title: Sell ornate gear

rules.notes: Launders stolen equipment that would give useful crafting inspiration, so it can be deconstructed. Place before other inspiration rules.
rules.title: Launder stolen inspiration

rules.notes: Routes equipment for deconstruction to the highest-priority character who hasn't fully leveled the corresponding crafting skill. If the current character benefits, the item is deconstructed locally; otherwise it's routed via the bank.
rules.title: Deconstruct for inspiration

rules.notes: Launders stolen task-type items (writs, maps, etc.) so they can be completed or banked.
rules.title: Launder stolen task items

rules.notes: Stashes holiday event writs in the bank. Complete them during events for bonus rewards.
rules.title: Bank holiday writs

rules.notes: Stashes master writs in the bank. Master writs reward writ vouchers for high-end crafting station furnishings.
rules.title: Bank master writs

rules.notes: Stashes treasure maps in the bank for later use. Treasure maps lead to chests with set gear.
rules.title: Bank treasure maps

rules.notes: Deposits empty (white quality) soul gems in the bank. Filled and crown soul gems are kept.
rules.title: Bank empty soul gems

rules.notes: Prevents museum pieces from being affected by lower-priority rules. These are turn-in items for collections or achievements.
rules.title: Protect museum pieces

rules.notes: Prevents quest-related items from being affected by lower-priority rules. Keep them safe until the associated quest is completed.
rules.title: Protect quest items

rules.notes: Deconstructs non-crafted equipment that wasn't caught by higher-priority rules. Place below equip, research, and inspire rules to only deconstruct what's left over.
rules.title: Deconstruct leftover equipment

rules.notes: Deconstructs non-crafted glyphs for enchanting materials. Yields runes that can be reused in crafting.
rules.title: Deconstruct glyphs

rules.notes: Launders stolen crafting materials so they can be deposited or used.
rules.title: Launder crafting materials

rules.notes: Moves crafting materials to the craft bag when visiting the bank. Requires ESO Plus or a craft bag entitlement. If you do not have ESO Plus, toggle off craft bag access in the ESO Plus panel above — the destination will be redirected to the bank automatically.
rules.title: Stow crafting materials

rules.notes: Launders stolen treasures of epic quality or higher. These are worth keeping — sell them legitimately or bank for later.
rules.title: Launder epic+ treasures

rules.notes: Deposits tools (lockpicks, repair kits, etc.) in the bank for safekeeping.
rules.title: Stock tools

rules.notes: Banks epic quality or higher treasures for safekeeping or later sale.
rules.title: Bank epic+ treasures

rules.notes: Deposits miscellaneous trophies (keys, key fragments, toys, dungeon buff ingredients, material upgraders) in the bank for safekeeping.
rules.title: Bank trophies

rules.notes: Deposits Alliance War items (siege equipment, forward camps, repair kits, etc.) in the bank for safekeeping.
rules.title: Bank Alliance War items

rules.notes: Sells items categorized as trash. These have no crafting or collectible value.
rules.title: Sell trash

rules.notes: Sells items in the junk category at a merchant.
rules.title: Sell junk

rules.notes: Sells companion equipment of superior (blue) quality or lower. Higher-quality companion gear is preserved.
rules.title: Sell low-quality companion gear

rules.notes: Sells stolen treasures at a fence. Stolen treasures can't be sold to normal merchants.
rules.title: Fence stolen treasures

rules.notes: Sells treasures up to superior (blue) quality at a merchant. Higher-quality treasures are preserved for banking or guild store listing.
rules.title: Sell common treasures

rules.notes: Lists recipes you've already learned (known) with guild-store value >= 5000g. Raised from 1000 to match the uniform 5000g list line; known recipes under 5000g now route to the generic vendor-sell rule.
rules.title: List known valuable recipes on guild store

rules.notes: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted potions. Crafted and higher-quality potions are kept.
rules.title: Sell basic potions

rules.notes: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted poisons. Crafted and higher-quality poisons are kept.
rules.title: Sell basic poisons

rules.notes: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted food. Crafted and higher-quality food is kept.
rules.title: Sell basic food

rules.notes: Sells normal (white) quality non-crafted drinks. Crafted and higher-quality drinks are kept.
rules.title: Sell basic drinks

rules.notes: Sells any sellable item with guild-store value (marketValue) < 5000g to a vendor, excluding legendary (quality 5) items. Value-axis sibling of valuable-nothing (list >= 5000).
rules.title: Vendor-sell sub-5000g non-legendary items

rules.notes: Destroys normal (white) quality items that have no guild store value and no merchant value. Place at the very bottom — only items not caught by any higher-priority rule are destroyed.
rules.title: Destroy worthless items

rules.goal: Dispose of scribing scripts once every character knows them
rules.title: Sell known scripts

rules.notes: Disposal spine step 5: known-by-all recipes to merchant; valuable ones list first via fc1c9638. Closes gap A1.
rules.title: Sell known recipes

rules.notes: Disposal spine step 5: learned + sellable + sub-list-line. Closes gap A3.
rules.title: Sell learned style pages

rules.notes: Disposal spine step 5. Closes gap A4.
rules.title: Sell known motif chapters

rules.notes: Spine step 6: below-superior drink with no merchant value (event drinks) cannot fall to the sell rules - destroy. Companion to the raised drink sell floor (A5).
rules.title: Destroy unsellable low drinks

rules.notes: Spine step 6, food parallel to drink (Alan 2026-07-05: food and drink parallel).
rules.title: Destroy unsellable low food
